title: Carry on business on conservation land only with authority
what: Sell goods or services, or carry on any business, on CALM land (such as national parks, conservation parks, nature reserves and marine parks) only with lawful authority, such as a commercial operations licence.

sources.title: Conservation and Land Management Regulations 2002 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not, without lawful authority, sell any goods or services, or carry on any business, on CALM land
